summary.en: One changed line, two registered renders of the same instant either side of the seam; the seam slides so the edit takes the frame over, landing on a bar line with the claim.
summary.zh: 改了一行，同一时刻的两张对齐渲染分在接缝两边；接缝滑过去，改后的那张占满画面，落在小节线上，主张同时落下。

fits: The climax of a film whose product turns a one-line change into a visible change.
notFor: Two renders that differ by more than the shown line; renders of different instants.

intent.en: Change one thing and show it twice: the edit takes the frame over.
intent.zh: 只改一处，展示两遍：这一处修改占满画面。

content.en: The line (number, before, after; ≤ 40 characters), two renders of one instant at one size, a claim in two phrases (≤ 8 words each).
content.zh: 这一行（行号、改前、改后；≤ 40 字符）、同一时刻同一尺寸的两张渲染、两段主张（每段 ≤ 12 字）。

fits.zh: 产品能把一行改动变成可见变化的片子的高潮。

notFor.zh: 两张渲染的差别不止这一行；不同时刻的渲染。

en: Give `bar` (the beat of its bar the scene starts on) so the slider lands on a bar line.
zh: 给出 `bar`（场景从所在小节的第几拍开始），滑块才落在小节线上。

fits: any film whose input maps line by line to an output

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
